$comment: Authoritative request/response contract for the multipart meal-photo lifecycle. Written by backend todo 3 and consumed by the Expo client (todo 4). Every shape here was verified against a running server on port 8099 with the e2e fixture profile; the captured traffic is in .omo/evidence/task-3-photo-meal-journal.json.

authentication.notes: Every meal endpoint including the photo byte stream requires the header. There is no cookie, query token or signed URL: an unauthenticated photo read is 401, never bytes.

meal.notes: photoAction MUST be omitted on create; sending it is 400. A new record has no photo to act on.

photo.notes: Bytes are decoded server-side; the declared content type and filename are not trusted. Omit the part entirely for a memo-only record. Do NOT send an empty part to mean 'no photo' - an empty part is rejected as an unreadable image.

responses.400: ErrorResponse (validation: empty record, bad JSON, missing meal part, unreadable/empty photo, malformed clientRequestId, photoAction present)
responses.409: ErrorResponse (clientRequestId reused with a different payload)
responses.413: ErrorResponse (photo above 10 MiB or above 40 megapixels)
responses.415: ErrorResponse (photo is not JPEG/PNG, or is animated)

responses.404: ErrorResponse (absent or not the caller's record)

revision.notes: The photo id from MealPhotoResponse.id. Use MealPhotoResponse.url verbatim rather than building this yourself.

200.body: raw sanitized JPEG bytes (starts FF D8 FF)

404.body: EMPTY - zero bytes, no JSON envelope
404.notes: Deliberately identical for all of: the record has no photo, the revision is stale, the record belongs to another user, the record was deleted. Byte-for-byte identical, verified by diff. Treat 404 only as 'show the placeholder'; never infer existence from it.

getMealPhoto.clientNotes: This is a binary response. Do not parse it as JSON. Attach the Authorization header; a plain <Image src> without the header will get 401.

MealRequest.$comment: The `meal` JSON part. Sent as a part with Content-Type application/json.

memo.notes: Trimmed server-side; a whitespace-only memo counts as absent. The 1000 character limit applies after trimming. Inner newlines, emoji and Korean text are preserved verbatim.

clientRequestId.location: a field of the `meal` JSON part (NOT an HTTP header)
clientRequestId.notes: Optional but recommended on create. Generate one UUID per draft and reuse it for every retry of that draft. Regenerate only when the user edits the draft.

MealRequest.recordInvariant: memo != null || the resulting record has a photo. Evaluated on the POST-UPDATE state: REMOVE on a record whose memo is empty is 400. Violations return 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with details[].field == "memo".

MealResponse.$comment: Fields whose value is null are OMITTED entirely (Jackson NON_NULL), so check for key presence, not for null.
MealResponse.absentFields: No calorie, macro, item or nutrition field is ever returned. No objectKey, bucket, endpoint, signed URL or credential is ever returned.

id.notes: Also the revision. Changes on every REPLACE; the previous value then 404s.

width.notes: Pixels of the stored image. Longest edge capped at 2048.

byteSize.notes: Bytes of the stored JPEG, not of the client's original upload.

contentType.notes: Always JPEG: a PNG upload is re-encoded.

checksumSha256.notes: SHA-256 of the stored bytes. Safe to use as a cache key.

url.notes: Relative authenticated API path. Prefix with the API base URL and send the Authorization header. This is NOT a public or signed URL and it will not load without the token.

MealListResponse.ordering: Records with an eatenAt come first ordered by eatenAt ascending, then records without one, ties broken by id ascending.
MealListResponse.absentFields: No day total of any kind.

errorEnvelopes.when: KEEP or REMOVE sent with a photo part

details.message: 사진을 교체할 때만 사진을 보낼 수 있습니다.

errorEnvelopes.when: REPLACE sent without a photo part

details.message: 사진을 교체하려면 새 사진을 함께 보내주세요.
사진 처리 방식(KEEP, REMOVE, REPLACE)을 지정해주세요.

errorEnvelopes.when: the photo is unreadable, corrupt, SVG or zero bytes

body.message: 사진을 읽을 수 없습니다. 다른 사진을 선택해주세요.

errorEnvelopes.when: memo longer than 1000 characters after trimming
the meal part is not valid JSON, or the parts were swapped
no or invalid bearer token, on any endpoint including the photo stream
the meal is absent or belongs to another user (JSON endpoints)
GET photo: absent / stale revision / foreign owner / deleted meal
errorEnvelopes.notes: Empty body, no envelope. All four cases are byte-identical by design.

errorEnvelopes.when: clientRequestId reused with a different payload
the upload exceeds the 10 MiB multipart limit, or the image exceeds 40 megapixels
the photo decoded as something other than a still JPEG/PNG (e.g. animated GIF/APNG)

body.message: JPEG 또는 PNG 사진만 올릴 수 있습니다.

errorEnvelopes.when: private photo storage is unreachable or not configured yet

body.message: 사진 저장소를 사용할 수 없습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요.

errorEnvelopes.notes: Retryable. No record is created; a memo-only write still succeeds during the outage.

idempotency.location: the `clientRequestId` field of the `meal` JSON part
idempotency.scope: per user - two users may use the same UUID without colliding
idempotency.sameIdSamePayload: 201 with the ORIGINAL record (same meal id, same photo id). No duplicate row and no second stored object.
idempotency.fingerprint: SHA-256 over mealDate, mealType, eatenAt and the normalized memo. Photo bytes are NOT part of it, so retrying with a re-encoded copy of the same image still replays rather than conflicts.
idempotency.lifetime: The mapping is deleted with its meal, so the same UUID may be reused after the record is deleted.

photoLimits.notes: EXIF and GPS metadata are stripped by re-encoding; EXIF orientation is baked into the pixels. Client-side downscaling before upload is recommended but not required.

clientChecklist: Build the body with FormData and let the HTTP client set the multipart boundary; never set Content-Type manually on the whole request.
Omit photoAction on create; always send it on update.
Never send an empty `photo` part to mean 'no photo' - omit the part.
Render photos from MealPhotoResponse.url with the Authorization header; never cache or expose it as a public URL.
Treat a 404 from the photo endpoint as 'show a placeholder', with no inference about existence.
Keep one clientRequestId per unsaved draft across retries.
